Squall Canopy.name: Squall Canopy
Squall Canopy.description: The user swells their personal storm cloud across a whole city block for the rest of the scene, filling the street with rain, static cover and guided wind channels. Each turn they can drop a charged downdraft on foes in the block for heavy force and electric damage that pins and numbs them until the end of their next turn, or lift allies a story high on static updrafts; held back, the downdrafts only hold foes flat. Sustaining both natures across a block scrambles every radio and camera inside and triggers the user's Drawback at once. Strain: severe.
